[IRET.28.15.1] Engine-level invariants compose with `ds_oa_check`: per
negation node, a token's block count — the facts its `ltok_idx_map` entry
lists ([IRET.7.9.4]) — equals the number of `ridx_map` lists containing it;
`ridx_map` and `ltok_idx_map` are mutual inverses; `lmem_map`'s size equals
`left_count`; every `act_map` value is a live activation also on the
activation list.
